items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and flush coolant
items.note: If coolant got into the oil, add an oil change and possibly bearing damage. Steel-core replacement gaskets are recommended.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or loses forward gears
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transmission costs less. On a high-mileage car, compare the cost to the car value first.

items.t: Long, harsh shifts with code P1811 or P0748
items.job: Replace pressure control solenoid or recondition valve body
items.note: One owner paid about $350 for a shift kit to cure P1811.

items.t: Harsh clunk into reverse or drive
items.job: Diagnose and perform transmission bulletin repair

items.t: Transmission cooler lines rust and leak
items.job: Replace transmission cooler lines
items.note: RepairPal lists cooler line replacement at about $119–$152.

items.t: Plastic coolant elbows and upper intake leak
items.job: Replace coolant elbows or upper intake manifold and gaskets

items.t: Misfire from corroded fuel injector connections
items.job: Clean or replace fuel injector connectors

items.t: Hard starts and rough idle from clogged fuel injectors
items.job: Fuel injector cleaning service or injector replacement

items.t: Engine stalls from a failing crankshaft or airflow sensor
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor or mass airflow sensor

items.t: Misfire from a failing ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil

items.t: Oil leak from oil pan gasket or rear main seal
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket (rear main seal costs more)
items.note: A rear main seal needs the transmission removed and can run 8 or more labor hours.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
items.job: Replace both valve cover gaskets

items.t: Rear air shocks or leveling compressor fail
items.job: Replace rear air shocks and/or leveling compressor
items.note: Owners report about $350–$500 for rear shocks and a compressor.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hums or has play
items.job: Replace front hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Worn front struts and suspension parts
items.job: Replace front struts (pair) and align

items.t: Clunk or rattle from the steering column
items.job: Replace lower steering shaft or bearing per bulletin

items.t: Power steering moan or squawk at low speed
items.job: Flush power steering fluid or perform bulletin repair

items.t: Shake or vibration at highway speed
items.job: Road-force balance or replace tires
items.note: Tires or wheels that need replacing add cost.

items.t: ABS or traction light from a wheel speed sensor
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor or front hub

items.t: Heater and A/C blend door actuators fail
items.job: Replace HVAC mode or temperature door actuator

items.t: Leaking fuel pressure regulator can cause a backfire and fire (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pressure regulator (recall 04V-090)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Anti-lock brake defect can lengthen stopping (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair ABS (recall 97V-064)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belt system may not hold in a crash (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair seat belt anchorage (recall 97V-036)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Shoulder belt can jam in the retractor (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace shoulder belt retractor (recall 00V-117)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Loose brake booster nuts can affect braking (recall)
items.job: Install and torque brake booster nuts (recall 99V-238)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Car can pull to one side when braking (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair brakes (recall 99V-081)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: ABS unit can leak internally (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace ABS hydraulic unit (recall 00V-114)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor cover (recall 00V-346)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Emergency trunk release can be hard to pull (recall)
items.job: Reposition trunk release cable (recall 02V-328)
items.note: Free at a Buick dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN.
